text: {"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "Fixed strncasecmp() in lib/string.c, which decremented s1 (`*s1--`) instead of incrementing it, so the comparison walked backwards through the first string."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strcspn() iterated with `--p` instead of `++p`, so it walked backwards; I changed it to `++p`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_get_size(), the loop that reduces a size of 32 bits or more decremented the unit index (`i--`) instead of incrementing it, so large sizes got the wrong unit suffix; I changed it to `i++`."}
